sources.snippet: Contrastive vision-language learning uses paired chest CT volumes and radiology reports to learn abnormality classifiers without manually annotated labels. However, two characteristics of chest CT challenge conventional global contrastive learning. sources.title: GitHub - quin-med-harvard-edu/arc-ct: ARC-CT: Anatomy-Routed ...
sources.snippet: ARC-CT is a region-aware contrastive vision-language framework for 3D chest CT. It learns from paired CT volumes and their radiology reports, without manual annotations or bounding boxes, and classifies 18 abnormalities zero-shot by comparing a volume against text prompts.
